Package io.mdudel.zenoh.purejava.wire

Class PushExts

java.lang.Object
io.mdudel.zenoh.purejava.wire.PushExts
public final class PushExts extends Object
Factory helpers for the three PUSH-scope network extensions currently modelled by this client:
  • qos(Qos) - extension id 0x01, Z64, non-mandatory. Carries the packed Qos byte.
  • timestamp(Timestamp) - extension id 0x02, ZBuf, non-mandatory. Carries the serialised Timestamp.
  • nodeId(long) - extension id 0x03, Z64, mandatory (M=1 on the wire, matching Rust zextz64!(0x3, true)). Carries a 32-bit routing id in a varint.

These ids come straight from Rust commons/zenoh-protocol/src/network/push.rs::ext: QoS = zextz64!(0x1, false), Timestamp = zextzbuf!(0x2, false), NodeId = zextz64!(0x3, true).

Callers that use buildPushExtensions(Qos, Timestamp, long) get an extension list that is empty (i.e. no extensions to emit) when every argument is at its default. This lets a publisher emit byte-identical wire output to the pre-QoS version of this client when the caller does not opt in.

  • Method Details

    • qos

      public static Extension qos(Qos qos)
      QoS extension for PUSH. Non-mandatory; Z64-encoded packed byte. The Rust codec omits this extension when the QoS equals its default; this helper does not decide that -- callers should gate on Qos.isDefault() themselves. See buildPushExtensions(Qos, Timestamp, long).

    • timestamp

      public static Extension timestamp(Timestamp ts)
      Timestamp extension for PUSH. Non-mandatory; ZBuf-encoded serialised Timestamp (NTP64 varint + length-prefixed ZID bytes).

    • nodeId

      public static Extension nodeId(long nodeId)
      NodeId extension for PUSH. Mandatory per Rust source (zextz64!(0x3, true)): receivers that don't recognise it MUST refuse the enclosing message. Z64-encoded 32-bit routing id.
      Parameters:
      nodeId - 32-bit unsigned routing id (0 skipped by buildPushExtensions(io.mdudel.zenoh.purejava.wire.Qos, io.mdudel.zenoh.purejava.wire.Timestamp, long))
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the id doesn't fit in a u32

    • buildPushExtensions

      public static List<Extension> buildPushExtensions(Qos qos, Timestamp ts, long nodeId)
      Build the extension list for a PUSH from the three high-level knobs a publisher can currently set. Extensions are appended in ascending id order (0x01, 0x02, 0x03) per Zenoh convention.

      Skip rules (matching the Rust codec):

      • QoS: omitted iff qos.equals(Qos.DEFAULT) or qos == null.
      • Timestamp: omitted iff ts == null.
      • NodeId: omitted iff nodeId == 0.

      If all three skip, returns Collections.emptyList() so the caller's Z-flag stays clear and the wire output is byte-identical to the pre-QoS client.
